project_info.theme: Black roses gothic lakeside shoulder-turn portrait
project_info.color_palette: washed cool gray, black, pale skin, misty water

main_subject.type: adult woman using a required approved-adult face reference
main_subject.detail: An adult woman whose face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression match the attached approved-adult reference. She has long straight hair lightly tousled by wind and wears a black thin-strap evening top. She holds a bouquet of black roses close to her face.
main_subject.style: cinematic realism with dark-romantic gothic influence

items: standing with back angled to camera and head turned over shoulder
bouquet of black roses is a main foreground element
misty lakeside or riverside with cool gray overcast sky
face and roses sharp, water background softly blurred

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: muted highlights, low-contrast shadows, gentle rim on wind-tousled hair

technical_specs.render_style: 85mm f/2 cinematic portrait with shallow depth
technical_specs.color_treatment: desaturated neutral grays and washed cool tones, fine film grain, natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic gothic lakeside portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. She stands with her back angled toward camera, turns her head over her shoulder, and looks toward viewer with a soft melancholic gaze. She has long straight hair lightly tousled by wind, wears a black thin-strap evening top, and holds a bouquet of black roses close to her face. Set her beside misty water under a gray overcast sky. Keep face and roses sharp against a softly blurred lakeside, using soft diffuse daylight, muted highlights, low-contrast shadows, desaturated cool gray tones, 85mm f/2 shallow depth, cinematic realism, and natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, backless clothing, identity blending, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach a required approved-adult face reference. Preserve adult face, facial structure, likeness, shoulder-turn pose, black thin-strap evening top, black roses, misty lakeside, and cool overcast mood. Do not use a celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-reference
assets.usage: Keep adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly consistent.
